program_alignment.information_value: A decoder benchmark is uninterpretable until the D4 public record has a declared factor-graph likelihood. The exact 8-vertex, 12-edge primitive control can falsify an incorrect local adapter without new Monte Carlo cost, but cannot validate paper-normalized scale behavior.

question_and_knowledge_states.question: Does the validated first-stage public D4 observation likelihood admit a truth-free factor-graph representation whose weights agree exactly with the existing oracle on the complete primitive-size-2 support?
question_and_knowledge_states.smallest_claim: The audit may establish or reject exact finite-support factor-graph expressibility for the registered representations; it cannot establish BP accuracy, scalability, or logical performance.
established_external_knowledge: Jing et al. Appendix A defines the D4 observation support and conditional likelihood through flux boundary, degree-two charge measurements, and independent parity constraints.
Belief matching requires an explicit factorized likelihood over latent error variables before BP marginals can be interpreted as approximating a declared posterior.
The published D4 [2] practical decoder is herald-weighted PyMatching, not belief propagation or ILP.
current_project_evidence: R4.2 enumerates all 4096 physical masks, 16230 distinct nonwinding public observations, and 49855 compatible observation-error pairs with exact normalization.
Lab 002's current vertex likelihood is specific to a binary degree-threshold herald and is not a D4 likelihood adapter.
R5a validates the published public D4 policies as finite-size baselines but does not define a belief factor graph.
assumptions_and_constraints: latent variables are the twelve binary edge indicators of the primitive periodic size-2 fixture; this is not paper-normalized L=2
public inputs are only the flux syndrome and typed charge outcomes
physical error, component decomposition, fusion history, logical sector, and simulator relation metadata are forbidden decoder inputs
the Bernoulli edge prior uses the same p values as R4.2: 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, and 0.6
competing_outcomes: Local degree/support and explicit parity factors reproduce every oracle likelihood exactly.
Local support is insufficient but a public auxiliary-variable parity construction is exact.
No registered bounded factorization is exact; any scalable D4 belief-matching adapter must be labelled a variational approximation or use a richer representation.
question_and_knowledge_states.negative_and_censored_outcomes: Any positive oracle weight assigned zero by a candidate, any forbidden chain assigned positive weight, or any normalized posterior discrepancy rejects that branch. Resource overflow censors implementation rather than supporting non-factorizability.

primary_source.location: Appendix A and D4 [2] decoder discussion
primary_source.effect: fixes the observation support and likelihood while prohibiting the project's phenomenological binary-herald factor from being treated as source-equivalent

research_basis.remaining_gap: No public observation-only D4 factor graph has been shown to reproduce the exact conditional likelihood consumed by the validated oracle.

scientific_model.hidden_information: physical error, connected components, pairing or fusion history, logical sector, and truth-derived post-flux relations
scientific_model.target_weight: P(E;p) P(O2|E) for each public observation and candidate physical error
scientific_model.exact_control: the frozen R4.2 distinct-observation likelihood and posterior enumeration

scientific_model.resolution_limit: Exact primitive-size-2 expressibility does not establish the same representation on the paper-normalized L=2 supercell, BP accuracy, or acceptable scaling of factor arity and runtime.

registered_methods.design: complete deterministic primitive-size-2 enumeration over all 12-edge physical masks and distinct public O2 observations for F0-F2
registered_methods.inputs: frozen R4.2 enumeration and source-hashed D4 likelihood plus Lab 002 BP interface
registered_methods.verification: unit fixtures for vacuum, open string, branched component, trivial loop, winding terminal, parity violation, and hidden-field rejection before the complete matrix
registered_methods.analysis: classify each factorization as exact, support-only, mismatched, or resource-censored; identify the smallest exact public representation if one exists
registered_methods.budget: under ten CPU minutes and 2 GiB; deterministic enumeration only; zero Monte Carlo samples
registered_methods.stop: do not implement BP recurrence, produce logical corrections, time scalability, or run R6 performance if no exact/public candidate passes
registered_methods.escalation: no human ranking is needed: all three registered branches are cheap and discriminating; consult only if every exact candidate fails and adopting an approximate likelihood would change the scientific interpretation
